newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs end up on weaker-than-expected output data.
newsitem.headline: JGBs end up on weaker-than-expected output data.

text.p: * Key June 10-year JGBs ended higher as weaker-than-expected April industrial output data triggered hectic buying back.
* Earlier, June fell on concern over possibility of early rise in discount rate after BOJ said late Wednesday it would release next "tankan" survey on June 25 rather than in early July.
